title: Constitution saving throws
html:
List of all effects that use Constitution Saving Throws. The listed effects may have additional properties that are not mentioned here because they are not part of the Constitution Saving Throw.

Features

Class Features

Class Subclass Name Level DC Effect
Barbarian Wild Magic Barbarian  Bolt of Light 3 12? Target takes 1d6 Radiant Damage and becomes  Blinded
 Dark Tendrils 3 12? Each creature within 9 m (30 ft) of you takes 1d12⁠⁠Necrotic damage. Additionally, you gain 1d12 Temporary Hit Points
Cleric Light Domain  Radiance of the Dawn 2 Spell Save DC Hostile Creatures within 9 m (30 ft) of you take 2d10 + Character Level⁠⁠Radiant damage unless they have full cover.
Druid None  Wild Shaper Spider  Venomous Bite 2 13 Affected entity becomes  Poisoned.
 Wild Shape Owlbear  Enrage 6 17 Affected entities within 18 m (60 ft) become  Fearful.
 Wild Shape Dilophosaurus  Corrosive Spit 10 Spell Save DC The target's  Armour Class decreases by 1 per turn, to a maximum penalty of -5, and it takes 1d10⁠⁠Acid damage per turn. Water removes the spit and its effects.
Circle of the Moon  Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon  Electrified Flail 10 13 Affected entities becomes  Stunned.
 Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon  Grounded Thunder Strike 10 13 Affected entity becomes  Prone.
 Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon  Scorching Strike 10 13 Affected entity starts  Burning.
 Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon  Hiemal Strike 10 13 Affected entity becomes  Chilled.
Circle of the Spores  Halo of Spores 2 Spell Save DC Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage. Increases to 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic at Level 6 and to 1d8⁠⁠Necrotic at Level 10.
 Spreading Spores 10 Spell Save DC Affected entities takes 2d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Monk None  Stunning Strike 5 Weapon Action DC Affected entity becomes  Stunned.
Ranger Beast Master  Wolf Spider Companion  Venomous Bite 3 Spell Save DC Affected entity becomes  Poisoned.
 Wolf Companion  Infectious Bite 5 Spell Save DC Affected entity becomes  Poisoned.

Conditions

Name Saving Throw Trigger DC Effect
 Reverberation 5 or more stacks/turns 10 Affected entity falls  Prone
 Encrusted with Frost 7 or more stacks/turns 12 Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Cold and becomes  Frozen for 2 turns. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and the stacks go away.

Spells

All spells except Dethrone have their DC be determined by the Spellcasters Spell Save DC.

Name Spell Level Effect
 Poison Spray Cantrip 1d12⁠⁠Poison damage, increases to 2d12⁠⁠Poison at Level 5 and to

3d12⁠⁠Poison at Level 10. Saving against the spell negates the damage.

 Ray of Sickness Level 1 Affected entity becomes  Poisoned.
 Searing Smite Level 1 For 10 turns the target takes 1d6⁠⁠Fire until it succeeds the  Constitution Saving Throw.
 Thunderwave Level 1 Affected entities are pushed away from the spellcasting direction. Saving halves damage and negates the push effect.
 Blindness Level 2 Affected entities become  Blinded.
 Branding Smite Level 2 Affected entities can not turn  Invisible anymore.
 Heat Metal Level 2 Creatures holding metal weapons will drop the weapon. On save the creature will gain  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Ability Checks as long as the spell is maintained. The spellcaster can reactivate the spell effect as a bonus action. Spell damage is applied without save.
 Moonbeam Level 2 Affected entities take 2d10⁠⁠Radiant damage when entering/starting their turn in the area of effect. Saving halves the damage.
 Shatter Level 2 Affected entities take 3d8⁠⁠Thunder damage. Saving halves the damage.
 Blinding Smite Level 3 The affected entity is  Blinded.
 Sleet Storm Level 3 Affected entities have to succeed or their  Concentration will be broken.
 Stinking Cloud Level 3 Affected entities have to succeed or they can't take Actions.
 Blight Level 4 Affected entity takes 8d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage. Plants take maximum damage and have  Disadvantage against

the saving throw. Saving against the spell halves the damage.

 Cloudkill Level 5 Affected entities takes 5d8⁠⁠Poison damage. Saving against the spell halves the damage.
 Cone of Cold Level 5 Affected entities takes 8d8⁠⁠Cold damage. Saving against the spell halves the damage.
 Contagion Level 5 If an affected entity fails three  Saving Throws before the spell ends, it contracts a

Disease of the spellcaster's choice.

 Destructive Wave Level 5 Affected entities take 5d6⁠⁠Thunder + 5d6⁠⁠Radiant/5d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage and fall

 Prone. Saving against the spell halves damage and negates  Prone.

 Dethrone Level 5 Affected entities take 10d6 + 20⁠⁠Necrotic damage. Saving against the spell halves damage. Dethrone has set DC of 18.
 Insect Plague Level 5 Affected entities take 4d10⁠⁠Piercing damage. Saving against the spell halves damage.
 Circle of Death Level 6 Affected entities take 8d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage. Saving against the spell halves damage.
 Flesh to Stone Level 6 Affected entity is  Restrained. It makes a  Saving Throw at the end of each turn. If it fails 4 times while the spell is active it becomes  Petrified.
 Harm Level 6 Affected entity takee 14d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage and reduces their hit point maximum by the same amount. It can reduce a creature to below 1 hit point. Saving against the spell halves damage and retains maximum hit points.
 Otiluke's Freezing Sphere Level 6 Affected entities take 10d6⁠⁠Cold damage. Saving against the spell halves damage.
 Sunbeam Level 6 Affected entities takee 6d8⁠⁠Radiant damage and are  Blinded for 10 turns. Saving against the spell halves damage and negates the condition.

Unique Actions

Name Skill Type DC Effect
 Let the Slaughter Begin Slayer Transformation Skill ? Affected entities become  Dazed for 1 turn and when they diein the next 4 turns, the Slayer gains +1  Armour Class.
 Piercing Growl Slayer Transformation Skill Spell Save DC? Affected entities starts  Bleeding and become  Fearful for 2 turns each.
 Sumptuous Blood Bath Slayer Transformation Skill Spell Save DC? Affected entities starts  Bleeding for 3 turns.

Weapon Actions

Contains all non-unique Weapon Actions that are determined by weapon type. The DC's of the effects can be determined via the Weapon Action DC of the wielder. Some unique Weapons like Shar's Spear of Evening may have additional weapon actions that from this list that are not part of their unique actions and are not a weapon action from their weapon type category. Some Weapons may have their type-specific Weapon Actions replaced by other features.

Name Weapon Type Effect
 Heartstopper Morningstars Affected entity has  Disadvantage on  Constitution Saving Throws and has one fewer  Action for two turns. It can be removed by healing.
 Pommel Strike Greatswords, Longswords Inflicts  Dazed for 2 turns.
 Concussive Smash Clubs, Flails, Greatclubs, Light Hammers, Maces, Mauls, Morningstars, Warhammers Inflicts  Dazed for 2 turns.
 Maiming Strike Battleaxes, War Picks Inflicts  Maimed for 2 turns.
 Lacerate Battleaxes, Handaxes, Glaives, Greatswords, Halberds, Longswords, Scimitars, Sickles Inflicts  Bleeding for 2 turns.
 Piercing Strike Daggers, Javelins, Pikes, Rapiers, Shortswords, Tridents, War Picks Inflicts  Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Targets take an additional 2⁠⁠Piercing Damage when hit by a attack. Can be removed by healing.
 Piercing Shot Hand Crossbows, Heavy Crossbows, Light Crossbows Inflicts  Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Targets take an additional 2⁠⁠Piercing Damage when hit by a attack. Can be removed by healing.
 Hamstring Shot Longbows, Shortbows Inflicts  Hamstrung for 2 turns. Affected entity has 50% reduced Movement Speed.

Items

Items that grant spells that use Constitution Saving Throws are not mentioned within this section unless they're unique and only avialable through the given item.

Items that inflict Conditions that trigger Constitution Saving Throws are stil mentioned here.

Weapons

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Hunter's Dagger On Hit 13 Affected Entity becomes  Ruptured. The entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Piercing damageevery 1 m (3 ft) and the condition's duration is reduced by one turn.
Kurwin's Cauteriser On Hit 13 Affected Entity starts  Burning.
Lightning Jabber On Hit 13 Affected Entity becomes  Shocked.
Rupturing Blade  Searing Blood Weapon Action DC Affected Entity starts  Burning and  Bleeding for 2 turns.
Blackguard's Sword On-Hit Smite 13 Affected Entity is  Dazed for 2 turns.
Cold Snap Attack misses wearer 13 Affected Entity becomes  Chilled for 2 turns.
Cruel Sting  Ensnaring Strands Spell Save DC? Affected Entity becomes  Enwebbed for 2 turns.
Fleshrender  Part the Flesh Weapon Action DC Affected entity can't be healed and can't gain Temporary Hit Points.
Least Expected  Blinding Shot Weapon Action DC (??) Affected entity becomes  Blinded for 2 turns.
Sussur Dagger On Hit 12 Affected entity becomes  Silenced for 2 turns.
Sussur Sickle
Sussur Greatsword
Soulbreaker Greatsword  Soulbreaker Weapon Action DC Affected entity becomes  Stunned for 2 turns.
Justiciar's Scimitar On Hit with  Advantage 14 Affected entity becomes  Blinded for 2 turns.
Mourning Frost Deal ⁠⁠Cold spell damage 12 Affected entity becomes  Chilled for 2 turns.
Staff of the Ram On Hit  Recharge: Per turn 8 Affected entity is pushed back 2 m (7 ft) and is  Stunned for 1 turn.
The Sacred Star  Dawnburst Strike Weapon Action DC Affected entities in a  AoE: 3 m (9 ft) Radius become  Blinded for 3 turn.
The Blood of Lathander Undead/Fiends in a  AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius radius around the wearer 14 Affected entities becomes  Blinded for 1 turn (?).
Silver Sword of the Astral Plane  Soulbreaker Weapon Action DC Affected entity becomes  Stunned for 2 turns.

Amulets

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Amulet of Selûne's Chosen  Selune's Dream 10 Affected entity starts  Sleeping for 2 turns.
Spineshudder Amulet On Hit Spell Attack No DC Affected entity gains 2 turns of  Reverberation.
The Spectator Eyes  Wounding Ray Spell Save DC Affected entity takes 2d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage. On Save: Target still takes half damage.

Rings

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Burnished Ring  Paralyzing Ray Spell Save DC Affected entity becomes  Paralysed for 2 turns.

Headwear

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Coldbrim Hat Any spell condition inflicted on a target  Recharge: Per turn No DC Affected entity gains  Encrusted with Frost for 2 turns.

Handwear

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Gloves of Belligerent Skies Deal Thunder, Lightning or Radiant damage No DC Affected entity gains  Reverberation for 2 turns.
Winter's Clutches Deal ⁠⁠Cold damage No DC Affected entity gains  Encrusted with Frost for 2 turns.
Flawed Helldusk Gloves On Hit with Unarmed Strike 13 Affected entity starts  Bleeding for 2 turns.
Poisoner's Gloves Deal ⁠⁠Poison damage 13 Affected entity becomes  Poisoned for 2 turns.
Helldusk Gloves On Hit with Unarmed Strike 15 Affected entity starts  Bleeding for 2 turns.

Footwear

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Boots of Stormy Clamour Inflict a Condition No DC Affected entity gains  Reverberation for 2 turns.

Cloaks

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Thunderskin Cloak Creature with  Reverberation deals damage to the wearer 13 Affected entity becomes  Dazed for 2 turns.

Miscellaneous

Name Feature Type DC Effect
Signed Trade Visa  Flesh to Gold Spell Save DC Affected entity is  Restrained. It makes a  Saving Throw at the end of each turn. If it fails 4 times while the spell is active it becomes  Petrified.

Grenades

Name Craftable DC Effect
Suspicious Poison (when thrown) No 13 Affected entities within the Poison Cloud become  Poisoned for 3 turn. They take 3d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the start of their turn unless they succeed the saving throw, which removes the condition. (?)
Flashblinder Yes 16 Affected entities in a 6 m / 20 ft (Radius) become  Blinded. Steel Watchers or Scrying Eyes become  Stunned for 2 turns (1 turn in Honour Mode)

Coatings

All coatings can also be thrown to create AoE surfaces or clouds that apply the effect similar to a grenade-like item. There might be differences in DC's of AoE effect vs. the DC of the coating?

Name Craftable DC Effect
Oil of Diminution Yes 11 Affected entity is  Reduced.
Basic Poison Yes 11 Affected entity is  Poisoned.
Drow Poison Yes 13 Affected entity is  Poisoned and will start  Sleeping.
Crawler Mucus Yes 13 Affected entity is  Poisoned and  Paralysed.
Karabasan's Poison No 13 Affected entity is  Poisoned and  Paralysed.
Malice Yes 15 Affected entity is  Poisoned and  Blinded.
Simple Toxin Yes 11 Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Serpent Fang Toxin Yes 13 Affected entity takes 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Wyvern Toxin Yes 15 Affected entity takes 1d8⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Purple Worm Toxin Yes 19 Affected entity takes 1d10⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
Thisobald's Brewed-Up Bellyglummer Yes 17 Affected entity is  Poisoned and takes 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.
